{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the presence of commas in revenue
revenue_with_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False)
print(f'Rows with commas in revenue: {revenue_with_commas.sum()}')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
cleaned_revenue = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify the cleaning worked by checking a few values
print(f'First 5 cleaned revenue values: {cleaned_revenue.head().tolist()}')"}
